node.statement: The diagonal corner identity S_{Q,Q}=S_Q and the EXT-CB hypothesis dim S_Q=1 give dim S_{Q,Q}=1. Taking e_sel to be the minimum of the finitely many positive universal thresholds used in the preceding children proves (dim S_{P,Q},dim S_{Q,Q})=(r,1) for every datum with e<=e_sel.
